title: Highmarsh 家庭因子剂量说明
instruction:
你是艾格尼丝·祖贝尔 (Agnes Zubair)，纽约 Highmarsh Foundry 儿童止血服务中心的注册护士协调员，你还剩下一节课要和 Iris Underwood (68) 一起教学，然后她会开车四个小时回家，带着她 7 岁的孙子和被监护人 Aleksy Schuyler 过冬。艾里斯将在没有其他受过训练的成年人在场的情况下给予他的第八因子，包括过夜。 Renata Zuniga 要求您修改当前的讲义，因为它读起来像是课堂解释，而不是 Iris 可以在上午 2 服用的药物，而且配药做法正在仲冬发生变化。阿列克西于 11 月 15 2026 称重 24.6 公斤。他目前的处方计划是，对于疑似关节或肌肉出血，使用25 IU/kg；对于疑似头部、颈部或腹部出血或重大损伤，使用50 IU/kg。还显示已确认的 27.5 kg 和 30 kg 重量的预测，但在确认重量之前不要提供预计剂量作为使用许可。他目前供应的整瓶药标有262 IU、536 IU 和1,048 IU。从1一月2027开始，Anvilcross Engineering Specialty Pharmacy预计仅分配536 IU和1,048 IU强度。不使用部分小瓶，并且选定的整瓶组合所提供的剂量不得低于计算的剂量。
Bohdan Haldorsen 的药房审查还表示，该表必须将产品订购、替代、存储和重构详细信息留给药房标签和药房团队，而不是制定新的药房说明。准备一份可编辑的、大字体的家庭因子剂量和出血反应说明书，Iris 可以快速浏览该说明书，涵盖过渡库存和预期的最终状态，而无需让她协调两个文件。内容不要超过两页，是为没有临床背景的护理人员编写的，并且不要将其变成通用输液手册。请勿发明电话号码、额外的规定费率或额外的药瓶规格；在需要本地联系方式的地方使用清晰标记的可编辑空白。自 15 11 月 2026 起适用纽约执业边界。使用文件名`aleksys_home_factor_guide.docx`将完成的文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `aleksys_home_factor_guide.docx` — 适用于非临床护理人员的可编辑、大字体家用因子 VIII 剂量和出血反应说明书。 （渲染页面不得超过两页；必须在一份文档中说明当前和转换后的小瓶可用性；必须保持可编辑；不得发明联系号码、剂量率或小瓶强度；必须使用准确的文件名写入工作目录的顶层。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
ALEKSY SCHUYLER
HOME FACTOR VIII DOSING & BLEED-RESPONSE GUIDE
For Iris Underwood • Use during the current plan; this sheet is education, not a new prescription.
IF A HEAD / NECK / ABDOMINAL BLEED OR MAJOR INJURY IS POSSIBLE: call 911 / emergency services now. Give the prescribed 50 IU/kg factor promptly if it is available and you can give it safely—do not delay transport, assessment, or emergency care.

1  QUICK PATH AT 2 A.M.

1. Identify the event. Joint or muscle symptoms use 25 IU/kg. Head, neck or abdominal symptoms, or a major injury, use 50 IU/kg (emergency). If unsure, call the hemostasis team—do not guess.
2. Confirm today’s weight in kilograms before choosing a row. Do not estimate, round, or use a future projection. If the confirmed weight is not 24.6, 27.5, or 30 kg, call for a new dose.
3. Check the stock-period box below. Read and verify the IU potency printed on every vial label. If labels do not match that box, do not substitute or improvise; call the hemostasis or pharmacy team.
4. Use only whole vials. Do not split a vial or save a partial vial for a later dose. The listed total may be higher than the calculated target so the dose is not under the target.
2  CURRENT STOCK  |  262 IU + 536 IU + 1,048 IU

Use this box while those three labeled strengths are in the home. Calculated IU = confirmed kg × prescribed IU/kg.

3  EXPECTED PHARMACY CHANGE  |  FROM 1 JANUARY 2027

Projected rows (27.5 kg and 30 kg) are planning aids only. They become usable only after that exact weight is confirmed and the treating team’s plan remains current.
4  RECOGNIZE THE EVENT

Do not wait for visible swelling. Early treatment and a phone call matter.
POSSIBLE JOINT BLEED  →  25 IU/kg
Pain, warmth, tingling, stiffness, guarding a joint, a limp, or less movement than usual. Swelling may be absent.
POSSIBLE MUSCLE BLEED  →  25 IU/kg
New pain or swelling with a change in movement or function; a limb may feel tight or be hard to use. Concerning limb symptoms need prompt advice.

5  EMERGENCY RESPONSE  |  50 IU/kg

Treat any blow to the head as a possible serious bleed—even if Aleksy looks well at first. Watch for worsening headache, vomiting, unusual sleepiness, confusion, seizure, weakness, or loss of consciousness.
Neck warning signs: swelling, voice change, trouble breathing or swallowing. Abdominal warning signs: significant pain, swelling, repeated vomiting, faintness, or a hard/tender belly. Major injury means substantial trauma or bleeding that worries you.
Call 911 / emergency services for serious head, neck, or abdominal symptoms, breathing trouble, loss of consciousness, seizure, collapse, or other life-threatening change. Do not delay transport for factor, a callback, or diagnostic certainty.
While help is being arranged, give the prescribed 50 IU/kg factor if it is available and you can give it safely. Notify the hemostasis team promptly after emergency help is activated or factor is given.
If you are unsure which category applies, call urgently rather than guessing. Repeat or additional doses, a changed rate, or a changed treatment plan require direction from the hemostasis treatment team or authorized prescriber.
6  SAFETY STOP

Stop administration and call 911 for trouble breathing, facial or throat swelling, widespread hives, faintness, or collapse (possible severe allergic reaction). If venous access cannot be obtained promptly or the dose cannot be completed safely, stop repeated attempts and seek help; never delay emergency care.
7  BEFORE / AFTER THE DOSE

Before use: read the pharmacy label and follow the pharmacy team’s instructions for ordering, product substitution, storage, and reconstitution. This sheet does not add temperatures, shelf-life rules, diluent volumes, infusion rates, or product instructions.
Check the product is not expired. Record vial potency and lot information. Record the date and time, suspected bleed or injury, body site or symptoms, selected dose, and whether emergency services or the clinical team was contacted.
8  CONTACTS & TEACH-BACK

Round-the-clock hemostasis team
Name/phone: __________________________________________
Specialty pharmacy (Anvilcross)
Name/phone: __________________________________________

Before leaving teaching, Iris can say: (1) which signs use 25 vs 50 IU/kg; (2) how she confirms weight and stock period; (3) how she reads each vial’s IU label; and (4) when she calls 911, the hemostasis team, or the pharmacy team.
Caregiver notes / event log:  Date/time __________  Event/site or symptoms ______________________________  Dose/vials __________________  Lot(s) __________  Help contacted __________________

criteria.description: 所需的 DOCX 存在于顶层的确切文件名下，并作为有效的 Word 文档打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认 `aleksys_home_factor_guide.docx` 存在于工作目录根目录中并且可以打开或解析而无需修复。

original.criterion: The required DOCX exists at the top level under the exact filename and opens as a valid Word document.
original.evidence: Submitted file and DOCX package structure.
original.grader_hint: Confirm `aleksys_home_factor_guide.docx` is present at the working-directory root and can be opened or parsed without repair.

criteria.description: 完整的说明书不超过两页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准办公套件渲染文档并计算所有页面，包括溢出创建的页面。

original.criterion: The complete instruction sheet renders in no more than two pages.
original.grader_hint: Render the document using a standard office suite and count all pages, including pages created by overflow.

criteria.description: 实质性说明、剂量信息和联系字段仍然可编辑，而不是仅以扁平页面图像的形式提供。
criteria.evidence: DOCX 文本、表格、字段和绘图对象。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查包或打开文件并验证是否可以选择主要内容并将其编辑为文本或表格内容。

original.criterion: The substantive instructions, dosing information and contact fields remain editable rather than being supplied only as flattened page images.
original.evidence: DOCX text, tables, fields and drawing objects.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the package or open the file and verify that the main content can be selected and edited as text or table content.

criteria.description: 该表使用真正清晰的大字体格式和足够的间距，可供 68 岁的护理人员通宵查阅。
criteria.grader_hint: 将渲染的工件判断为实用的床头参考。正文、表格条目和警告不应仅仅依靠狭窄的细则来满足页码上限。

original.criterion: The sheet uses genuinely legible large-print formatting and sufficient spacing for a 68-year-old caregiver consulting it overnight.
original.grader_hint: Judge the rendered artifact as a practical bedside reference. Body text, table entries and warnings should not depend on cramped fine print merely to satisfy the page cap.

criteria.description: 对于没有临床背景的护理人员来说，语言直接、简单且以行动为导向。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找简短、具体的说明和必要的术语解释。密集的临床散文、无法解释的缩写或课堂式的阐述不应获得满分。

original.criterion: The language is direct, plain and action-oriented for a caregiver with no clinical background.
original.grader_hint: Look for short, concrete instructions and necessary terms explained in place. Dense clinical prose, unexplained abbreviations or classroom-style exposition should not receive full credit.

criteria.description: 该表清楚地标明了阿列克西·斯凯勒 (Aleksy Schuyler) 的身份，并指出这是他的家庭因子 VIII 剂量和出血反应指南。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认患者姓名和文件的家庭因素剂量/出血反应目的出现在显着位置。

original.criterion: The sheet clearly identifies Aleksy Schuyler and states that it is his home factor VIII dosing and bleed-response guide.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both the patient name and the document's home factor dosing/bleed-response purpose appear prominently.

criteria.description: 当前体重信息显示 24.6 kg 并将其与 15 十一月 2026 相关联。
criteria.grader_hint: 值及其测量日期都必须存在并且明显链接，而不是显示为不相关的日期和数字。

original.criterion: The current-weight information states 24.6 kg and associates it with 15 November 2026.
original.grader_hint: Both the value and its measurement date must be present and visibly linked, rather than appearing as unrelated dates and numbers.

criteria.description: 正确区分两种规定剂量率：25 IU/kg（疑似关节或肌肉出血）和50 IU/kg（疑似头部、颈部或腹部出血或重大损伤）。
criteria.evidence: 剂量标签、决策辅助或响应说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每一次出现的速率和指示。满分要求将比率始终附加到正确的出血类别。

original.criterion: The two prescribed dose rates are correctly distinguished: 25 IU/kg for suspected joint or muscle bleeding and 50 IU/kg for suspected head, neck or abdominal bleeding or major injury.
original.evidence: Dosing labels, decision aid or response instructions.
original.grader_hint: Check every occurrence of the rates and indications. Full credit requires the rates to be attached to the correct bleed categories throughout.

criteria.description: 该表给出了易于理解的剂量关系，其中计算出的 IU 等于确认的重量（千克）乘以适用的规定 IU/kg 比率。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受简单的语言措辞或公式。拒绝按重量划分的关系，忽略速率或暗示小瓶强度决定处方剂量。

original.criterion: The sheet gives an intelligible dosing relationship in which calculated IU equals confirmed weight in kilograms multiplied by the applicable prescribed IU/kg rate.
original.grader_hint: Accept plain-language wording or a formula. Reject relationships that divide by weight, omit the rate or imply that vial strength determines the prescribed dose.

criteria.description: 在重量、计算剂量或小瓶数量可能会混淆的地方，公斤和国际单位都被明确标记。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查标题、行标签和散文。护理人员不必推断一个数字是重量、规定的比率还是因子的数量。

original.criterion: Kilograms and international units are labeled unambiguously wherever weights, calculated doses or vial amounts could otherwise be confused.
original.grader_hint: Inspect headings, row labels and prose. A caregiver should not have to infer whether a number is a weight, a prescribed rate or an amount of factor.

criteria.description: 剂量辅助剂涵盖所有三个规定体重的规定反应类别：24.6 kg、27.5 kg 和30 kg。
criteria.evidence: 剂量表或等效的结构化内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认六种体重/类别组合中的每一种都有一个可操作的条目，而不仅仅是护理人员必须从中推断的示例。

original.criterion: The dosing aid covers both prescribed response categories at all three stated weights: 24.6 kg, 27.5 kg and 30 kg.
original.evidence: Dosing table or equivalent structured content.
original.grader_hint: Confirm there is an actionable entry for each of the six weight/category combinations, not merely examples from which the caregiver must extrapolate.

criteria.description: 25 IU/kg 类别的每个显示计算剂量等于相关的规定重量乘以 25 IU/kg，仅允许在不改变小瓶选择的情况下进行舍入。
criteria.evidence: 关节或肌肉类别的计算剂量值。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据重量重新计算每个显示值。三个不四舍五入的目标是615 IU、687.5 IU 和750 IU；仅当后续整瓶选择仍满足未舍入目标时，等效透明舍入才是可接受的。

original.criterion: Every displayed calculated dose for the 25 IU/kg category equals the associated stated weight multiplied by 25 IU/kg, allowing only presentation rounding that does not alter vial selection.
original.evidence: Calculated-dose values for the joint or muscle category.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate each displayed value from its weight. The three unrounded targets are 615 IU, 687.5 IU and 750 IU; equivalent transparent rounding is acceptable only if subsequent whole-vial choices still meet the unrounded target.

criteria.description: 50 IU/kg 类别的每个显示计算剂量等于相关的规定重量乘以 50 IU/kg，仅允许在不改变小瓶选择的情况下进行舍入。
criteria.evidence: 紧急类别的计算剂量值。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据重量重新计算每个显示值。三个目标是1,230 IU、1,375 IU 和1,500 IU。

original.criterion: Every displayed calculated dose for the 50 IU/kg category equals the associated stated weight multiplied by 50 IU/kg, allowing only presentation rounding that does not alter vial selection.
original.evidence: Calculated-dose values for the emergency category.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate each displayed value from its weight. The three targets are 1,230 IU, 1,375 IU and 1,500 IU.

criteria.description: 该指南明确表示要使用整个小瓶，而不是分开或保存部分小瓶以供以后服用。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的整瓶说明以及明确禁止部分瓶使用或保留的规定。

original.criterion: The guide explicitly says to use whole vials and not to split or save a partial vial for a later dose.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit whole-vial instruction plus a clear prohibition on partial-vial use or retention.

criteria.description: 当前库存部分准确标识了262 IU、536 IU 和1,048 IU 的标签功效。
criteria.evidence: 当前库存密钥或剂量表。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有这三种优势都必须存在并确定为当前库存。其他发明的优点未能满足该产品的精确性。

original.criterion: The current-stock section identifies exactly the stated labeled potencies of 262 IU, 536 IU and 1,048 IU.
original.grader_hint: All three strengths must be present and identified as current stock. Additional invented strengths fail the exactness aspect of this item.

criteria.description: 对于当前库存，每个 25 IU/kg 小瓶组合均达到或超过其未四舍五入的计算目标，并使用可用整瓶强度中可达到的最低总效力，用最少的小瓶打破平局。
criteria.evidence: 当前库存关节或肌肉剂量条目。
criteria.grader_hint: 枚举262、536 和1,048 IU 的组合。对于每个规定的重量，验证没有剂量不足和最低合格总量；所有三个重量应解析为 786 IU 作为三个 262 IU 小瓶。

original.criterion: For current stock, every 25 IU/kg vial combination meets or exceeds its unrounded calculated target and uses the lowest attainable total potency from the available whole-vial strengths, with the fewest vials used to break a tie.
original.evidence: Current-stock joint or muscle dosing entries.
original.grader_hint: Enumerate combinations of 262, 536 and 1,048 IU. For each stated weight, verify both no underdose and minimum qualifying total; all three weights should resolve to 786 IU as three 262 IU vials.

criteria.description: 对于当前库存，每个 50 IU/kg 小瓶组合均达到或超过其计算目标，并使用可用整瓶强度中可达到的最低总效力，用最少的小瓶打破平局。
criteria.evidence: 当前库存紧急剂量条目。
criteria.grader_hint: 枚举整瓶组合。在24.6 kg 时，使用1,048+262 的最低合格总数为1,310 IU；在27.5 kg 和30 kg 时，使用1,048+262+262 为1,572 IU。

original.criterion: For current stock, every 50 IU/kg vial combination meets or exceeds its calculated target and uses the lowest attainable total potency from the available whole-vial strengths, with the fewest vials used to break a tie.
original.grader_hint: Enumerate whole-vial combinations. At 24.6 kg the minimum qualifying total is 1,310 IU using 1,048+262; at 27.5 kg and 30 kg it is 1,572 IU using 1,048+262+262.

criteria.description: 预期的过渡后库存仅限于规定的 536 IU 和 1,048 IU 强度。
criteria.evidence: 转换后库存钥匙或剂量表。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认最终状态部分列出了预期的强度，并且不将 262 IU 强度带入转换后的选择中。

original.criterion: The expected post-transition stock is limited to the stated 536 IU and 1,048 IU strengths.
original.evidence: Post-transition stock key or dosing table.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the end-state section lists both expected strengths and does not carry the 262 IU strength into the post-transition choices.

criteria.description: 对于预期的过渡后库存，每个25 IU/kg 输入使用达到或超过计算目标的最低整瓶总量。
criteria.evidence: 过渡后关节或肌肉剂量输入。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅使用536 IU 和1,048 IU 小瓶，每个规定重量的最低合格总量为一瓶1,048 IU 小瓶。

original.criterion: For expected post-transition stock, every 25 IU/kg entry uses the lowest whole-vial total that meets or exceeds the calculated target.
original.evidence: Post-transition joint or muscle dosing entries.
original.grader_hint: Using only 536 IU and 1,048 IU vials, the minimum qualifying total for each stated weight is one 1,048 IU vial.

criteria.description: 对于预期的过渡后库存，每个50 IU/kg 输入使用达到或超过计算目标的最低整瓶总量。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅使用536 IU 和1,048 IU 小瓶，每个规定重量的最低合格总量为1,584 IU，来自一瓶每种规格。

original.criterion: For expected post-transition stock, every 50 IU/kg entry uses the lowest whole-vial total that meets or exceeds the calculated target.
original.grader_hint: Using only 536 IU and 1,048 IU vials, the minimum qualifying total for each stated weight is 1,584 IU from one vial of each strength.

criteria.description: 当前库存和预期的过渡后指令明显不同，因此护理人员不太可能从错误的库存期间选择组合。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断标签、视觉分组和措辞是否使这两种状态在匆忙使用过程中清晰无误，而无需在不同的文档之间进行比较。

original.criterion: Current-stock and expected post-transition instructions are visibly distinct, so a caregiver is unlikely to select a combination from the wrong stock period.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether labels, visual grouping and wording make the two states unmistakable during hurried use without requiring comparison across separate documents.

criteria.description: 这一转变与 1 一月 2027 相关，并被描述为预期的药房变化，而不是保证不同的药瓶无法到达。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找日期和适当的条件性措辞，例如预期或计划。

original.criterion: The transition is tied to 1 January 2027 and described as an expected pharmacy change rather than a guarantee that different vials cannot arrive.
original.grader_hint: Look for the date and appropriately conditional wording such as expected or planned.

criteria.description: 27.5 kg 和30 kg 条目已明确标记为预测值，只有在确认相应的重量后才能使用。
criteria.evidence: 预计重量表标签和附近的说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 当使用预计剂量时，限制必须是可见的；如果该表以其他方式读取为立即授权，则远程通用免责声明是不够的。

original.criterion: The 27.5 kg and 30 kg entries are clearly labeled as projections that may be used only after the corresponding weight has been confirmed.
original.evidence: Projected-weight table labels and nearby instructions.
original.grader_hint: The limitation must be visible where projected doses are used; a remote generic disclaimer is insufficient if the table otherwise reads as immediately authorized.

criteria.description: 该指南告诉看护者在选择体重行之前先确定孩子当前的确认体重，并且不鼓励估计或四舍五入孩子的体重。
criteria.evidence: 剂量选择之前或伴随的说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受简洁的措辞。操作信息必须是使用确认的重量，而不是目视估计或假设的未来重量。

criteria.description: 该指南为护理人员提供了可能出现肌肉出血的可识别迹象，包括疼痛或肿胀以及功能或运动变化，并根据需要及时提供建议来处理有关的肢体症状。

spec.professional_context: A pediatric hemostasis nurse is converting a reviewed teaching handout into a caregiver-facing tool for independent home use. The guide must remain mathematically accurate while accommodating a planned pharmacy transition and respecting the boundary between nursing education, prescribing and pharmacy instructions.
difficulty_sources: Maintaining exact weight-based dosing and whole-vial rounding across two bleed categories, three weights and two inventory states
Making projected future rows useful without presenting them as current authorization
Balancing rapid caregiver navigation against a two-page large-print limit
Providing safe bleed-response education while respecting prescribing and pharmacy boundaries
Revising explanatory material into an operational tool that can be used without live support

authoring_plan.solver_instance: Create a compact caregiver-facing home factor VIII dosing and bleed-response guide from the patient-specific facts embedded in the request, using professional nursing knowledge for bleed recognition, escalation, teach-back and scope boundaries.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: A strong solution is mathematically exact, usable during a stressful overnight event, explicit about the transition and end state, and bounded so it does not become a prescription or pharmacy handling manual.
required_imperfections_and_tensions: The caregiver must use current inventory during a transition and later use an inventory from which one strength has disappeared; the document must support both states without requiring two guides.
Projected weights are needed for planning, but they are not permission to use a row before that weight is confirmed.
Whole-vial rounding creates substantial overfill in some end-state cases; the guide must preserve the prescribed minimum rather than smoothing the arithmetic into an underdose.
The nurse owns caregiver education and response guidance but not product substitution, dispensing, storage, reconstitution specifications, new dose rates or repeat-dose authorization.
No real telephone numbers are available, so the usable artifact needs conspicuous editable contact fields rather than invented details.
gold_relationships: For each weight and indication, calculated IU equals confirmed weight in kilograms multiplied by the prescribed IU/kg rate.
The lower-dose calculated targets derive from multiplying each stated weight by 25 IU/kg.
The emergency calculated targets derive from multiplying each stated weight by 50 IU/kg.
A qualifying vial selection uses whole vials only and has total labeled potency greater than or equal to the unrounded calculated target.
Among qualifying selections from the applicable stock set, use the lowest total potency; if totals tie, use the selection with fewer vials.
Current-stock combinations may use only 262 IU, 536 IU and 1,048 IU vials.
Post-transition combinations may use only 536 IU and 1,048 IU vials.
Projected-weight rows are planning outputs and become actionable only after the corresponding weight is confirmed.
If actual labels differ from the listed strengths, the caregiver does not extrapolate or substitute and instead contacts the treatment or pharmacy team.
Emergency response should allow prompt factor administration when safely possible while never delaying emergency services or transport.
Repeat dosing, altered dose rates and treatment-plan changes remain with the authorized clinical team.
professional_content_expected: Early, caregiver-recognizable joint and muscle bleed signs.
A low threshold for treating head trauma as potentially serious, including delayed neurologic symptoms.
Recognition of serious neck and abdominal symptoms and major injury.
A clear uncertainty path that does not require caregiver diagnosis.
Emergency-service triggers and instructions not to delay transport for infusion completion, callback or diagnostic confirmation.
Severe allergic-reaction response and a safe boundary when venous access or administration cannot be completed.
After-dose documentation covering event, time, site or symptoms, dose, vial potency, lot information and contacts made.
A brief teach-back or self-check appropriate to the final teaching session.
required_vocabulary_and_local_convention: The exact filename is supplied in the request.
The patient-specific weights, rates, vial strengths, transition date, jurisdiction and as-of date are supplied in the request.
Contact details must be represented by editable blanks labeled for the round-the-clock hemostasis service and specialty pharmacy.
The document should distinguish current stock from the expected post-transition stock using caregiver-visible wording; no private transition code is required.
authoring_plan.reference_files: None. All patient-specific and local facts required for scoring are contained in the solver-visible request; remaining expectations are standard professional knowledge for caregiver education about home factor therapy.
authoring_plan.offline_validation: A reference DOCX can be authored with python-docx, rendered with LibreOffice and checked offline. All vial totals can be generated by enumerating nonnegative whole-vial combinations from the applicable stock set and selecting the minimum total meeting each calculated target, breaking equal-total ties by vial count. The rendered reference can fit within two pages using readable large-print tables, short action blocks and compact editable contact and teach-back fields.

deliverables.description: Editable, large-print home factor VIII dosing and bleed-response instruction sheet for a nonclinical caregiver.
constraints: Must be no more than two rendered pages; must address current and post-transition vial availability in one document; must remain editable; must not invent contact numbers, dose rates or vial strengths; must be written into the top level of the working directory using the exact filename.

original_instruction:
You are Agnes Zubair, the RN nurse coordinator at Highmarsh Foundry Children’s Hemostasis Service in New York, and you have one teaching session left with Iris Underwood, 68, before she drives four hours home with her seven-year-old grandson and ward, Aleksy Schuyler, for the winter. Iris will be giving his factor VIII without another trained adult present, including overnight. Renata Zuniga has asked you to revise the current handout because it reads like a classroom explanation rather than something Iris can dose from at 2 a.m., and the dispensing practice is changing mid-winter. Aleksy weighed 24.6 kg on 15 November 2026. His current prescribed plan is 25 IU/kg for a suspected joint or muscle bleed and 50 IU/kg for a suspected head, neck or abdominal bleed or major injury. Show projections for confirmed weights of 27.5 kg and 30 kg as well, but do not present a projected dose as permission to use it before that weight is confirmed. His current supply has whole vials labeled 262 IU, 536 IU and 1,048 IU. From 1 January 2027, Anvilcross Engineering Specialty Pharmacy expects to dispense only the 536 IU and 1,048 IU strengths. Partial vials are not used, and a selected whole-vial combination must not provide less than the calculated dose. Bohdan Haldorsen’s pharmacy review also says the sheet must leave product ordering, substitution, storage and reconstitution details to the pharmacy label and pharmacy team rather than making new pharmacy instructions. Prepare an editable, large-print home factor dosing and bleed-response instruction sheet that Iris can navigate quickly, covering both the transition stock and the expected end state without making her reconcile two documents. Keep it to no more than two pages, written for a caregiver with no clinical background, and do not turn it into a general infusion manual. Do not invent telephone numbers, additional prescribed rates or additional vial strengths; use clearly labeled editable blanks where local contact details are needed. Apply New York practice boundaries as of 15 November 2026. Write the finished file into the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename `aleksys_home_factor_guide.docx`.
